character.name: Idle
character.prompt: 16-bit pixel art wizard character, 3/4 top-down perspective, strict 48x48 pixel grid scale, crisp outlines, dark violet hooded robes with glowing cyan arcane runes, holding a gnarled wooden staff topped with a large glowing blue crystal, clean retro SNES palette, centered on a transparent background.

rows.animation:
`Generate a 4-directional animated sprite sheet layout (facing North, South, East, West) using the loaded wizard character asset. Format the layout into a strict 48x48 pixel grid sequence matching the following grid order:
• Row 1: Idle loop, gentle up-and-down breathing bob, blue crystal gently pulsing.
• Row 2: Jogging loop, running animation with flowing robe physics, staff held out forward.
• Row 3: Projectile Cast, thrusting the staff forward sharply to launch a spell.
• Row 4: Power Channel, raising the staff high into the air with both hands, robes billowing upward.
• Row 5: Teleport Frame, a single frame of the wizard body dissolving into sudden vertical streaks of purple energy.`
